title: Review of c14's pcell-mwall (SIBDH): replicates on fresh seed 9; M wall layer rim/core 3.06 (116/126 cells), deaths at yield percentile 0.04 vs marker 0.64, mean yield 1.17 vs marker 0.87
summary: Fresh seed 9 (T=100000): labkit pack (11 persistent splits, generation 3, merge/split 0.24) and the author's exact genealogy (14 persistent splits, generation 3, 43 intrinsic deaths, 2 merges, 0 conversions). From noise ~20 cells form by t=4000 and stay a bounded population of 18-21 cells of mixed size with no giant body. The self-made wall material is a layer at every cell's wall: M rim/core 3.06, rim/outside 5.61, 116/126 individuals membrane-like. Mature-cell deaths sit at the 4th yield percentile (23/23 below the median; 6th at 2000 t before death) against the 64th (58th) for the identical-event inert marker; dying cells were low at birth (rank 0.36 -> 0.03 at death; marker 0.72 -> 0.71); low-born cells die more often than high-born (0.59 vs 0.31; marker 0.23 vs 0.60); particle-weighted mean yield rises to 1.17 while the marker drifts to 0.87.
